purpose: Section 6 order-diagnostic activation test, sealed before the first shakedown (quote-only shakedown starts 2026-10-22)
account: user's KIS mock-trading competition account (ends 2026-11-20), PAPER domain only; identifiers stay in /etc/hqa/xo001.env and are not recorded here

cancel_test.limit_price_rule: that session's lower price limit (cannot fill unless limit-down)
cancel_test.success: final remaining quantity 0 and order status cancelled, confirmed by inquiry

flatten.rule: market sell of all confirmed holdings from these tests; no new buys while holdings or UNKNOWN orders remain

pass_rule: all three test days must show: open order accepted with order number; fill price and quantity readable; cancel test confirmed cancelled. Any failure on any listed day -> diagnostic stays OFF for the main period.
main_account_check: separately required before 2026-11-30 per preregistration section 6
